test.create_query: CREATE TABLE mem_compressed_subcolumns (s String) ENGINE = Memory SETTINGS compress = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO mem_compressed_subcolumns SELECT if(number % 10 = 0, '', concat('https://www.example.com/', toString(number % 1000), '/catalog/item?id=', toString(number), '&ref=', repeat('x', number % 64))) FROM numbers_mt(20000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT count() FROM mem_compressed_subcolumns WHERE empty(s)
SELECT count() FROM mem_compressed_subcolumns WHERE notEmpty(s)
